description: This file defines a Java interface named Faultable that specifies methods for fault detection and fault state retrieval, used for devices that can report faults such as open doors or smoke presence.

classes.name: Faultable
classes.description: An interface for devices capable of fault detection, providing methods to set and check fault states.

methods.name: setFaulted
methods.description: Sets the fault state of the device, indicating whether a fault is present.

methods.name: isFaulted
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the device currently reports a fault.
